description: This file defines a serializer class 'TypeSerializerCodec' for serializing and deserializing the 'Type' class in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for writing and reading type information, handling well-known, referenced, and encoded types, and managing serialization details such as schema types and object references.

classes.name: TypeSerializerCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing serialization logic for the 'Type' class, supporting writing and reading type information with support for well-known, referenced, and encoded types.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Static method to write a 'Type' value without type info, determining schema type and serializing accordingly.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Static method to read a 'Type' value from the serialized data, reconstructing the type based on schema type and references.
